sections.content: Before shipping SQL to production, review: does it use indexes (EXPLAIN)? Is it parameterized? Does it paginate? Are NULLs and duplicates handled? What happens at 10x data volume?
Code review for queries matters as much as for app code — a bad query at scale takes down the whole app. Pair reviews and EXPLAIN-everything culture prevent incidents.
Key points: SELECT * hides cost, OFFSET pagination degrades on deep pages (use keyset), and monitoring slow-query logs catches regressions early.

sections.codeExample:
-- review checklist
-- [ ] EXPLAIN shows index usage
-- [ ] parameterized, no string concat
-- [ ] paginated (LIMIT/keyset)
-- [ ] NULL + duplicate edge cases tested
